edges.notes: Metal is Apple's GPU API on macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and related Apple platforms built on XNU-based stacks.
Overlapping low-overhead GPU graphics/compute API space; different primary platforms (Apple vs cross-vendor).
Apple deprecated OpenGL in favor of Metal on Apple platforms for new GPU development.
Overlapping GPU API space in cross-platform ports (Apple/Metal vs Windows/Direct3D is a common engine matrix).
